findings.evidence: "no color, type, spacing, radius or shadow literal in a component" and "each control is the shared component for its role" (line 81) largely activate familiar practices. The loading, tokens, consistency, a11y, interaction and NEVER sections contribute about 41 of 182 H2-section lines, primarily activation rather than new expertise; familiar material also appears within the workflow and Gotchas.
findings.fix: Compress familiar theme, shared-control, loading and focus guidance into terse rule criteria. Retain the distinctive source-versus-render proof rules, framework exceptions, decision branches and live-region timing details.

findings.evidence: "fail from source ... a declared width over 320 px ... with neither a max-width cap nor a breakpoint change" incorrectly treats declared width as used width. A flex item with width: 1200px, min-width: 0 and default flex-shrink can fit a 320px container without either exception, yet this branch mandates fail even when renders demonstrate reflow.
findings.fix: Account for flex shrinking and other layout constraints before declaring source-proven overflow. Treat a large declared width as na pending a render unless the inspected layout establishes that its used width cannot shrink to fit.

findings.evidence: "MUI Button, IconButton and other ButtonBase controls ship a focus-visible ripple, so in source they establish the interaction ring; add none" overgeneralizes component defaults. Direct ButtonBase defaults focusRipple to false, so a custom control using it can receive an incorrect interaction pass without any visible keyboard-focus treatment.
findings.fix: Limit the default-focus assumption to verified components and configurations. For direct ButtonBase and custom wrappers, inspect focusRipple, focus-visible styling and theme defaults; require a visible replacement when none is established.

findings.evidence: "load ... before using a figure as a fail line" conflicts with "Do not load it for an ordinary review or build": ordinary reviews routinely apply the numeric contrast, target-size and reflow fail lines.
findings.fix: Clarify that already-confirmed thresholds in SKILL.md need no additional provenance read; load references/sources.md for disputed, newly introduced or UNVERIFIED figures. Keep the source catalog and all attribution intact.
